# orch8_rollback_policy (Resource)

Automatic rollback policy for a sequence (`/rollback-policies`), keyed by tenant + sequence name. `POST /rollback-policies` upserts, so thresholds update in place (and re-enable the policy).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orch8_rollback_policy" "welcome" {
  sequence_name            = orch8_sequence.welcome.name
  error_rate_threshold     = 0.05
  time_window_secs         = 600
  cooldown_secs            = 3600
  confirmation_window_secs = 60
  webhook_url              = "https://alerts.example.com/orch8-rollback"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `error_rate_threshold` (Number) Error rate in [0, 1] that triggers a rollback.
- `sequence_name` (String) Sequence the policy watches.
- `time_window_secs` (Number) Evaluation window in seconds (> 0).

### Optional

- `confirmation_window_secs` (Number) Seconds the breach must persist (0–86400, engine default 60).
- `cooldown_secs` (Number) Minimum seconds between rollbacks (0–86400, engine default 3600).
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant. Defaults to the provider's tenant_id.
- `webhook_url` (String) Public URL to POST alerts to when a rollback triggers.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled.
- `id` (String) `<tenant_id>/<sequence_name>`.
- `policy_id` (Number) Engine row id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "<tenant_id>/<sequence_name>".
terraform import orch8_rollback_policy.welcome acme/welcome-email
```
